questions: Did s-bend progress rise above 0.1475 at y = 0.07 m, and did max_error stay near or below 0.061 m?
Did steering_oscillation stay below 0.16 on all tracks? If it rose above 0.16 with line loss at zero, the next step is y = 0.06 m.
Did line_loss_events change on the s-bend and slalom from 1.0 at y = 0.05 m? If line loss rose, is the cause the sensors seeing the bend early?
Did the oval keep 0 line loss and progress near 0.115 or higher?
Did any track complete? If not, which track ended off track first, and at what progress?
feedback_request.what_to_report: Per track (oval, s-bend, slalom): completion, progress, completion_time, rms_error, max_error, line_loss_events, steering_oscillation, control_effort, controller_errors. Also the kp that gave the best rms_error with this layout, and which sensors carry the most signal when the robot is on the line.

intent: Test a larger forward sensor lead (y = 0.07 m, from 0.05 m) on the iteration 5 platform, keeping seven contiguous 16 mm sensors at ±0.048 m, wheel_track 0.12 m, mass 0.8 kg and body 0.12 × 0.16 m. Iteration 5 raised s-bend progress from 0.04 to 0.1475 with oscillation 0.137, so forward lead is a working lever. I expect further s-bend progress and no oval line loss. I accept that line loss on the s-bend and slalom may persist.
learning: Iteration 5 (y = 0.05 m) was the first result to lift s-bend progress above 0.04 (to 0.1475), which shows forward lead works on this platform. Iterations 2 to 4 at y = 0.03 m, under kp, drivetrain and pitch changes, were stuck at 0.04. Line loss on the s-bend and slalom returned to 1.0 at y = 0.05 m, and this is the main open question for the next race.
rationale: Iteration 5 (y = 0.05 m, contiguous 16 mm sensors at x = ±0.048 m, wheel_track 0.12 m, mass 0.8 kg) met the Integrator's first success condition. S-bend progress rose from 0.04 to 0.1475, and steering_oscillation stayed at 0.1366, below the 0.16 trigger. The forward lead was therefore the first geometry change to move the s-bend, which the drivetrain change (iteration 4) and the gain change (iteration 3) never did. Two things remain. The s-bend and slalom each show one line-loss event per run, and slalom max_error is 0.0661 m, past the 0.06 m off-track limit. The oval is clean (0 line loss, progress 0.115). Iteration 4 showed that widening the pitch to 20 mm cut slalom progress, so I do not widen the pitch. The slalom progress of 0.105 is back at the iteration 2 level, so the 16 mm contiguous layout is still the better sensing choice. The Integrator's rule says that when s-bend progress rises with oscillation below 0.16, keep y = 0.05 m and test a further lead. I therefore move the sensors to y = 0.07 m, the upper end of the contract's forward range is 0.08 m, and I keep every other value fixed. This isolates the lead variable against iteration 5. Expected result: s-bend progress above 0.1475, steering_oscillation still below 0.16, and no added line loss on the oval. Line loss on the s-bend and slalom may persist or get worse, since sensors further ahead see the bend earlier and the lateral error they report lags the wheels more. If line loss rises or oscillation passes 0.16, the next step is y = 0.06 m, not further lead.
